SHAMANIC & INDIGENOUS TRADITIONS / CULTURAL ATLAS

Across lands.
Across languages.

A cultural atlas of shamanic and related Indigenous traditions. Thirteen situated pathways, with community names and public sources.

These are distinct living and historical traditions, not branches of one universal culture. “Shamanism” is a comparative term whose meaning and acceptance vary; the names used by each community guide the individual entries.
